Implement JSON Patch applyPatch (RFC 6902)

Export applyPatch(document, patch) from src/index.ts, with its six
operations add, remove, replace, move, copy and test. The input is never
mutated: the patch runs on a copy, and values taken from the patch are
copied on insertion. An invalid patch throws a SyntaxError before any
operation runs; a failing operation throws an Error.

resolvePointer and the patch code share one token walk. Tests cover each
operation, the RFC 6902 appendix examples, the error paths and
immutability. README documents the new function.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Record the outcome of task-002 (JSON Patch)

Describe what was implemented, how it was tested, and the decisions
taken: up-front patch checks, copying on insertion, and defining members
so that "__proto__" stays a plain key.
